recentItems.title: Brief: Israel locks down Hebron, why is WFP cutting aid to Gaza? | The Take
recentItems.description:

In this episode:

- Nour Odeh, Al Jazeera Correspondent
- Mohammed Vall, Al Jazeera Correspondent

recentItems.title: US support for Israel at record high as public backing cracks
recentItems.description:
As Israel heads to the polls, the US is stepping up its military and financial support for the country. The Trump administration has earmarked a massive $2.8bn munitions package for the country – part of the continuing acceleration of military support for Israel since the October 7th attacks. 

Al Jazeera’s Alan Fisher reports from Washington, DC - where there's growing concern among the American public about continuing support for a traditional ally.

recentItems.title: Thousands rally in Turkiye over journalist arrests, media shutdowns
recentItems.description:
